response.overview: A documentary that follows the 46 workers of the CANALE factory, now COTRAMEL, which went bankrupt and was abandoned by its owners more than seven years ago. After being laid off, they keep production going and withstand economic hardship and legal challenges in the face of the ever-present threat of eviction. They live in a perpetual present while the judge in the case must decide the fate of those means of production.
response.title: Recuperar un futuro
